from pathlib import Path
folder=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')
folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]

    # Horizontal bands encode a periodic sequence by row.
    if all(all(v == 0 for v in row) or (row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)) for row in grid):
        indices = [(r, grid[r][0]) for r in range(h) if grid[r][0] != 0]
        for p in range(1, h + 1):
            mapping = {}
            if all((i % p not in mapping or mapping[i % p] == v) and not mapping.setdefault(i % p, v) != v for i, v in indices):
                return [[mapping[r % p] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

    # Otherwise the colored strokes specify a periodic diagonal palette.
    diagonals = [([c-r for r, c, _ in cells]), ([r+c for r, c, _ in cells])]
    vals = [v for _, _, v in cells]
    offsets = min(diagonals, key=lambda x: len(set(x)))
    for p in range(1, max(h, w) + 1):
        mapping = {}
        valid = True
        for k, v in zip(offsets, vals):
            residue = k % p
            if residue in mapping and mapping[residue] != v:
                valid = False
                break
            mapping[residue] = v
        if valid:
            return [[mapping[(c-r if len(set(diagonals[0])) <= len(set(diagonals[1])) else r+c) % p] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
'''
# simplify risky row consistency expression afterwards by execution checks
path=folder/'task-676f8cb8.py'
path.write_text(program)
print(path)
